title: Sell safely, keep records and find your best-sellers

say: Sell safely, keep records, and find your best-sellers.
This is the video for module four of Handmade Accessories for Sale.
You do not need every channel. You need the one or two places your buyer already spends time.

say: Set up WhatsApp Business, separate from your personal WhatsApp, with a catalogue of your products, quick replies and labels like Paid and Sent. When someone asks, send the catalogue link.
Confirm the item, total price, delivery fee, payment method and delivery day in one message.
Check the payment in your own bank or wallet app before anything leaves your hands.

panel.heading: From enquiry to delivered order
panel.rule: Confirm every payment in your own bank or wallet app.

say: Pack carefully, and add a small thank-you card with your WhatsApp number and care instructions.

say: Watch for these tricks. Fake payment alerts are common, so always check in your own app.

cards.d: Screenshots and alerts can be faked. Check your own bank or wallet app before you send goods.
Never refund an overpayment until the full amount has cleared in your account.
Ignore paid verification or promotion messages. Never share one-time passwords or PINs.

say: Some buyers overpay and ask you to refund the difference. Never refund until the full amount has cleared.

say: Ada displays earrings by colour and builds matching sets of earrings, bracelet and headband at a set price. She checks every transfer in her app before handing over goods.
She sells 14 pairs of earrings at 2,500 naira.
9 bracelets at 2,000.
And 3 sets at 8,000.

That is 77,000 naira in sales. But sales are not profit. After the table fee, transport and the cost of the pieces, she knows her real profit. She also collects 11 phone numbers for new stock updates.
Write one line per sale on the day: date, product, quantity, price, cost, channel and customer's first name. Keep a stock count too.

panel.heading: Three numbers every month
items: Log every sale on the day
Profit per product: price minus cost, times qty

say: Each month, work out profit per product: price minus cost, times the number sold. That shows what really earns money.

panel.heading: Three numbers every month
items: Log every sale on the day
Profit per product: price minus cost, times qty

say: Then sell-through: pieces sold, divided by pieces made, times 100. 80 percent means it is in demand. 20 percent means it is sitting.

panel.heading: Three numbers every month
items: Log every sale on the day

say: And count repeat customers. Repeat buying is the strongest sign your quality is right.

items: Log every sale on the day

say: For example, Funmi's earrings sold 26 out of 30, that is 87 percent. Her totes sold 6 out of 8. Both are make more.

cards.d: Earrings: 26 of 30 sold, 87%. Totes: 6 of 8 sold. Both earn well.
Statement bracelets: 80% sold, but only 200 naira profit each, because they take 50 minutes.
Headbands: 3 of 10 sold, 30%. Ask buyers: is it quality, price or fit?

say: Now plan. Days 1 to 30, focus: make more of your best-sellers and fix one costing or quality problem.

panel.heading: One main job each month
items: Days 31 to 60: add one channel or design
Days 61 to 90: review and drop what fails

say: Days 31 to 60, grow: add one channel, such as a boutique on consignment, or one tested new design. Not both.

say: Days 61 to 90, review: compare your numbers with your starting month, and drop what is not working. Give every step a number and a date.

panel.rule: Write "make 40 pairs by 30 November", not "make more".

say: To remember. Sell where your buyer already shops. Confirm every payment in your own app. Log every sale on the day. Let profit and sell-through decide what to make. And plan with dates and numbers.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Sell in one or two channels where she already shops
Confirm payment in your own app; never share PINs
Log every sale on the day
Use profit and sell-through to decide
Plan 90 days with dated, numbered targets

say: Now open your first channel, start your sales log, and assemble your capstone with your reflection and 90-day plan. Small, honest sales with clear records are worth more than a big story.
